title: Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / SEZ / BTP Units
text: 6.15 Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / SEZ / BTP Units Supplies to other EOU / EHTP / STP / BTP / SEZ units shall be counted towards NFE provided that such goods are permissible for procurement by these units.
